text:
alejandra: Spike proposal: "affinity handoff" pattern to split the hotpath into a tiny routing layer + handoff to stateless executors. intent: isolate prefix churn and make tenant rollbacks cheap.

ben: short migration sketch?

alejandra: 1) flag routes to emit handoff header (observe). 2) deploy handoff service in shadow that records mappings. 3) enable read-through for pilot tenants. 4) flip writes after reconciliation.

surya: latency concern: extra hop. plan to colocate handoff on executor host and add a short router cache TTL (100ms). target median delta <0.5ms.

mona: batching semantics? executors keep batching; handoff returns batch_hint only. sidecars shouldn't batch.

ben: safety gates: canary 0.5% at peak, 5% off-peak; rollback if p95 > baseline+20% or error rate rises >0.05%.

ci-bot: pipeline: branch "affinity-handoff/spike" built — artifacts at https://ci.redwood.example/1001

surya: observability: handoff-hit, miss, seq-errors, per-tenant diff. tag spans with "handoff_phase" and "executor_ver".

alejandra: test plan: replay 10k sessions with jitter, golden-diff on top tenants, backfill top-k prefixes into handoff store. will draft RFC follow-up and tag @ben @surya @mona.
